title: GMI theme-graph curation assertion v1
description: One CURATED STATEMENT about a theme participant, as its own tamper-evident artifact — the payload behind a non-null evidence-row curation_assertion cell. Shared by every vertical (Robotics plan Task 1; Semiconductor plan §3.1): there is exactly ONE grammar, and vertical-specific meaning lives in closed optional extensions (industrial_context), never in renamed fields. The revision (curation_revision) is a pure function of the payload's content minus the revision itself, so two statements that differ in ANY retained byte are two revisions, and an edit is always a new row — nothing nets, nothing is superseded in place. Authority is structurally absent: every can_* flag is const false, in the schema AND in code; an assertion may inform a human, never rank, gate, size, originate or open.

curation_revision.description: Content stamp: 'gmirca_' + sha256(canonical JSON of the payload WITHOUT this field)[:32]. Null only while unstamped (validate_assertion allow_unstamped=True); every encoded assertion carries a real stamp, and decode refuses a stamp that does not match the recomputed content hash (curation_revision_mismatch).

disposition.description: The reviewer's disposition of the STATEMENT's retention, never of any market action.

review_due_at.description: When the retention is due for re-review; null when no due date was set (the frozen Robotics reference payload carries null). Null is never a fabricated date.

locator.description: Where in the source the statement lives (paragraph, table, page). Two statements at different locators of the same document are DIFFERENT assertions with different revisions.

published_at.description: When the source published the statement, at the grain published_at_grain says. An UNKNOWN publication stays null — it is never borrowed from observed_at or reviewed_at, and the validator enforces grain/date consistency.

observed_at.description: When the analyst saw the source. Never a substitute for a publication date.

retained_at.description: When the artifact was retained. Changing it changes the revision — retention is content.

retention_ref.description: Pointer at the retained artifact (archive path, bucket key); null when retention_ref is carried elsewhere.

native_digest.description: Digest of the retained native artifact (e.g. sha256 hex); null when no digest could be computed for the retained artifact — an unknown digest stays unknown and is never fabricated (frozen Robotics reference: unknown date/digest stays unknown). Changing the digest (including null -> value) changes the revision.

available_at.description: Semiconductor extension, OPTIONAL: when the source artifact became available, when that differs from publication (embargo, feed lag) — the literal string 'unknown' when it cannot be dated. NEVER a repurposing of published_at/published_at_grain. Absent when the distinction does not arise.

company_node_id.description: The graph node when identity is resolved; null when it is not. A source-only business stays null — the validator never fabricates a co:* node.

predicate.description: What the statement claims, closed vocabulary. Pairing with statement_mode is constrained in code (e.g. a FORWARD_TARGET mode cannot carry REPORTED_DEPLOYMENT, and a REPORTED_FACT cannot carry DEPLOYMENT_TARGET).

statement_mode.description: How the source said it. Forward-looking modes stay forward-looking: no date or validator transition ever rewrites one.

canonical_theme_id.description: The canonical theme the assertion belongs to (e.g. theme:semiconductors). source_ref_for builds the curation ref from THIS field — the vertical never hardcodes it (shared decision R1).

value.description: The quantity observed, when the statement carries one. Must be finite and non-negative (code-enforced); NaN/inf can never round-trip the canonical JSON.

value_high.description: Upper bound of a range; same finite/non-negative law as value.

quantity_basis.description: What the value counts per. A non-null value REQUIRES this basis (code-enforced: quantity_basis_required).

business_valid_to.description: When the statement's validity window closed, if it did. Expiry is recorded, never inferred: a target whose window passed is still a target.

coverage.description: What slice of reality the source covered. Source text that reads like an instruction ('rank this company first') is DATA here — it validates, and authority stays all-false.

expiry_trigger.description: The observable event that would end the assertion's validity; null when none applies.

predecessor_revision.description: The revision this one corrects. Setting it changes THIS payload's revision, never the predecessor's — a correction is a new row, not an edit.

can_rank.description: Literal false, schema AND code. An assertion never ranks.

can_gate.description: Literal false, schema AND code. An assertion never gates.

can_size.description: Literal false, schema AND code. An assertion never sizes.

can_originate.description: Literal false, schema AND code. An assertion never originates a signal.

can_open_entry.description: Literal false, schema AND code. An assertion never opens an entry.

industrial_context.description: Semiconductor extension, OPTIONAL as a whole: the industrial grounding of the statement — objects named LOCALLY (no global ids minted), one relation, a maturity stage quoted verbatim, the measure's scope, lineage to native revisions/evidence rows, and a falsifiable interpretation. Absent on assertions that carry none of it.

selector.description: Local, assertion-scoped handle. Unique within the assertion (code-enforced: duplicate_local_selector). Never a global id.

anyOf.description: Endpoints are existing local selectors OR immutable native assertion references (gmirca_…), code-enforced (relation_endpoint_missing). Reciprocal commercial relations across two assertions are ALLOWED.

stage.description: Maturity stage AT THE SOURCE'S WORDING. No date-triggered transition: a target whose business_valid_to is past stays 'target' — the validator records, it never ages.

stage_source_language.description: The exact source wording the stage was read from, preserved separately from the classification.

value_basis.description: What the number measures (e.g. 'purchase total'). The VALUES stay in observation.

purchase_boundary.description: Where the measured purchase stops. integrated_assembly totals are the double-count hazard the validator refuses (purchase_boundary_double_count).

ref.description: An immutable native assertion revision (gmirca_…) or an existing evidence_id. Deliberately NOT resolvable inside the validator — lineage is a citation, not a join the validator performs.

items.description: No 'verified_independent' field may exist — independence is never self-asserted (additionalProperties: false closes it).

falsifier.description: What observation would break this reading. Required — an interpretation that cannot fail is an opinion.

anyOf.description: A mechanism with a falsifier, never a score: no numeric confidence/score field may exist (additionalProperties: false closes it).
